configure_profiling_capture: configure profiling to start capturing at a specific step and capture a set number of steps
on_start_step_profiling: signal the start of a new step to the profiling system for capture tracking
range_push_profiling: push a named profiling range marker to annotate a code block for NVTX tracing
range_pop_profiling: pop the most recent profiling range marker to end an annotated code block
RangeContext_profiling: use RangeContext as a decorator or with statement to annotate a code block for profiling
